song.title: Jesus You Alone
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C Who is the great King of glory .G D C Seated on high in the heavens? oh . G Jesus, You alone .G C You are the Lord God Almighty .G D C Strong in compassion and mercy, oh . G Jesus, You alone
[P1] . D Em C I've searched the world for a love that could fill my heart . D Em C Nothing compares to the wonder of who You are
[C1] . G Holy . D All the earth singing, "Holy" . C All the angels cry, "Holy" . C Jesus, You alone . G Jesus, You alone (oh)
[V2] .G C You set the stars in the heavens .G G/B C You set the world into motion, oh . G Jesus, You alone .G C You breathed Your life in creation .G G/B C You walked among Your created, oh . G Jesus, You alone
[C2] . G Holy . D All the earth singing, "Holy" . Am All the angels cry, "Holy" . C Jesus, You alone . G Worthy . D All creation sings, "Worthy" . Am All the heavens exalt Thee . C Jesus, You alone . G Jesus, You alone
[V3] .G C You shed Your blood for salvation .G G/B C You broke the curse for our freedom, oh . G Jesus, You alone .G C You rose from death with the morning .G G/B C You'll come again in Your glory, oh . G Jesus, You alone .Am G D Oh, Jesus, You alone
[C3] . G Holy . D I can't help but sing, "Holy" . C How my heart cries out, "Holy" . C Jesus, You alone (oh) . G Worthy . D I lift my voice and sing, "Worthy" . Am I bow my life to exalt Thee . C Jesus, You alone . G Jesus, You alone
